title: HollyShorts Film Festival 2024
deck: Twenty years, three venues, one painting.
location: TCL Chinese Theatres, Egyptian Theatre and Japan House, Los Angeles
lede: For its 20th anniversary, HollyShorts got an original illustration of the Chinese Theatre. It went on a poster, a photo wall drawn first as a sketch, 10 badges and a full merchandise line.
challenge: The 20th anniversary edition ran across three venues, the TCL Chinese Theatres, the Egyptian Theatre and Japan House, and added two events to the screenings: the Alta Global Media Film Summit and the 20th Annual HollyShorts Award Show at the Egyptian Theatre. An anniversary asks for more than the usual set, and for one image strong enough to hold all of it.
work: That image is an original illustration of the Chinese Theatre, in full color above the red carpet, used as the poster and as a wide panorama.

At the TCL Chinese Theatres the production design covered the photo wall, step-and-repeat and red carpet, billboards, on-screen graphics, event signage and the lobby. The photo wall was drawn first as an annotated sketch, then built and lit. At the Egyptian Theatre, the award show had its own on-screen graphics, photo wall and step-and-repeat, digital billboards and the HollyShorts award.

The anniversary also got a full merchandise line of hoodies, shirts, hats and totes, and 10 badge designs. The award, a film reel, was drawn out in technical drawings of the film-strip plaque and placard before it was made.
system: A film reel, drawn for fabrication.
deliverables: Photo wall, step-and-repeat, red carpet, billboards, signage and lobby
Award show graphics, photo wall and digital billboards at the Egyptian Theatre
credits: Dalton Corr: art direction, poster illustration, merchandise, badges, award design, production design
press: The festival was covered by Variety, Deadline, the Daily Mail, AwardsDaily and TimeOut Los Angeles.
